title: Generalist Generative Agent: Open-ended design exploration with large language models
task: 开放式概念设计与程序化3D生成
inputData: 文本隐喻/设计任务 + 程序化建模上下文 + 渲染图像与JSON评价信息
contribution: 提出Generalist Generative Agent，以多智能体链路把抽象设计隐喻转化为建筑设计任务、Rhino/Grasshopper程序化建模代码、3D概念模型与视觉评价，探索LLM在开放式早期建筑设计中的生成、执行和自评估能力。
abstract: The paper investigates whether LLM-based agents can support open-ended early-stage architectural exploration by interpreting metaphors, formulating design tasks, producing procedural 3D models, and evaluating rendered outputs. The framework is designed to work with ambiguous conceptual inputs rather than a narrowly predefined design space.
methodology: The framework contains four agents. A Metaphor Agent generates architectural metaphors and traits; an Interpretation Agent converts them into design implications and tasks; a Modelling Agent produces procedural Python/RhinoCommon code that is executed in Rhino 8 and Grasshopper and iteratively repaired when necessary; and an Evaluation Agent uses GPT-4o vision on Blender-rendered models together with JSON metadata to score Metaphor Alignment, Conceptual Strength, Geometric Complexity, and Design-Task Adherence on a 1–5 scale. The modelling experiments compare zero-shot metaphor-only, zero-shot metaphor-plus-design-task, and few-shot/history conditions, with agent outputs exchanged through JSON and generated functions saved as Grasshopper-compatible Python files.
results: The study generated approximately 1,000 procedural designs and 4,000 rendered images from 20 metaphors. Across the reported experiment, 1,100 generation attempts yielded 992 valid model outputs after filtering failures, demonstrating that the agent chain can produce a broad variety of executable concept models and automatically assess them through visual evaluation. Results show meaningful diversity and stronger task adherence when design tasks or prior examples are supplied, while also exposing limitations in geometric robustness, code reliability, and the consistency of LLM-based self-evaluation for open-ended design.
taskEn: Open-ended concept design and procedural 3D generation
inputDataEn: Text metaphors/design tasks plus procedural-modeling context and rendered images/JSON evaluation information
operationEvidence: The agent chain generates architectural concepts and executable Rhino/Grasshopper code, executes and repairs that code to create parameterized 3D models, renders the outputs in Blender, and uses GPT-4o vision to evaluate generated designs against explicit conceptual and geometric criteria.
